## Summary
- Non-streaming `echo=true` raised `KeyError: 'text'` and streaming `echo=true` failed `DeltaMessage` validation when the last message content was a multimodal content list (e.g. `[{"type":"text",...},{"type":"image_url",...}]`).
- Echo now flattens content to text in both paths: only `type: "text"` parts are echoed (joined with newlines); non-text parts (images, audio, files) are skipped because they cannot be represented in the text response.
- Extracts a shared `_get_echo_text` helper used by both the streaming and non-streaming generators.

Fixes #48338

## Why this is not duplicating an existing PR
- PR #48339 fixes only the streaming side and has unresolved merge conflicts since 2026-07-29; it does not cover the non-streaming `KeyError: 'text'` path reported here for the first time.
- This PR fixes both paths with a shared helper and adds regression tests for both.

## Test commands and results
- `pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_echo_with_multimodal_content_non_stream tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py::test_echo_with_multimodal_content_streaming -v`
  - On `main`: both fail — `KeyError: 'text'` (`serving.py:1089`) and `DeltaMessage` ValidationError (`serving.py:653`)
  - With this PR: both pass
- `pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py -k "not gptoss and not GPTOSS"` → 213 passed, 10 deselected

## Model evaluation
Not applicable: frontend response-assembly change only; no changes to sampling, generation, or model outputs.

## AI assistance
This change was developed with AI assistance (Kscc); the submitting human reviewed all changed lines and test results.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

**Nothing blocking.** The comments below are optional suggestions. There is no need to push a fix for them before merging.

**Additional findings** (outside the current diff — GitHub can't attach inline comments there):

- 🟣 `vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/batch_serving.py` — pre-existing: Batch endpoint callers using `echo=true` with a text+image last message still get a 500 from `KeyError: 'text'` after this fix. The batch subclass keeps its own copy of the old inline echo logic at batch_serving.py:317-320, joining `msg["text"]` for every part. Fix: have this block call the new `self._get_echo_text(conversation, role)` too, so all three echo sites share one text-only flattening. `OpenAIServingChatBatch` already inherits it from `OpenAIServingChat`. A batch-endpoint test belongs next to the two new tests.

  <details><summary>Why this was flagged</summary>

  `OpenAIServingChatBatch` (batch_serving.py:34) subclasses `OpenAIServingChat` and serves /v1/chat/completions/batch. `BatchChatCompletionRequest.messages` (protocol.py:1156) is `list[list[ChatCompletionMessageParam]]`, so each conversation can carry image_url parts. Each conversation goes through `renderer.preprocess_chat` (batch_serving.py:99). With the "openai" content format, `parse_chat_message_content_parts` (chat_message.py:406-408) returns the wrapped list, and image parts become `{"type": "image"}` with no "text" key. When `echo=true` and the role matches, the join at batch_serving.py:318-320 evaluates `msg["text"]` for each part and raises `KeyError: 'text'`. This is the same crash the PR fixes in serving.py, now left on the sibling endpoint, so behaviour here matches the base. The diff never touches batch_serving.py, but the shared `_get_echo_text` it adds is directly reusable at this site.

  **Verification:** pre-existing. Trigger: a /v1/chat/completions/batch request with `echo=true` whose conversation's last message content is a text+image list, under the "openai" content format. batch_serving.py is not part of the diff and still indexes `msg["text"]` on every part, so an image part raises `KeyError: 'text'`. The base branch fails the same way by the same route, so merging makes nothing worse.

  </details>

@@ -3440,3 +3440,92 @@ async def test_non_streaming_finish_reason_matches_tool_calls(
     assert bool(choice.message.tool_calls) == (text != "Hello, how are you?"), (
         "finish_reason must reflect whether tool calls were emitted"
     )
+
+
+_ECHO_CONVERSATION = [
+    {
+        "role": "user",
+        "content": [
+            {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image:"},
+            {
+                "type": "image_url",
+                "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/cat.png"},
+            },
+        ],
+    }
+]
+
+
+def _make_echo_request(**kwargs) -> ChatCompletionRequest:
+    return ChatCompletionRequest(
+        model="test-model",
+        messages=[
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image:"},
+                    {
+                        "type": "image_url",
+                        "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/cat.png"},
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        echo=True,
+        add_generation_prompt=False,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_echo_with_multimodal_content_non_stream():
+    """echo=True with a multimodal content list must echo only the text
+    parts instead of crashing with a KeyError on non-text parts."""
+    serving = _build_minimal_metrics_serving_chat(False)
+    response = await serving.chat_completion_full_generator(
+        _make_echo_request(),
+        _single_request_output(_make_metrics_request_output()),
+        "chatcmpl-test-id",
+        "test-model",
+        conversation=_ECHO_CONVERSATION,
+        tokenizer=MagicMock(),
+        request_metadata=RequestResponseMetadata(request_id="chatcmpl-test-id"),
+    )
+    assert not isinstance(response, ErrorResponse)
+    content = response.choices[0].message.content
+    assert content is not None
+    assert content.startswith("Describe this image:")
+    assert "Hello" in content
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_echo_with_multimodal_content_streaming():
+    """echo=True with a multimodal content list must stream the echoed text
+    parts instead of failing DeltaMessage validation mid-stream."""
+    serving = _build_minimal_metrics_serving_chat(False)
+    request = _make_echo_request(stream=True)
+    chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    async for line in serving.chat_completion_stream_generator(
+        request,
+        _single_request_output(_make_metrics_request_output()),
+        "chatcmpl-test-id",
+        "test-model",
+        conversation=_ECHO_CONVERSATION,
+        tokenizer=MagicMock(),
+        request_metadata=RequestResponseMetadata(request_id="chatcmpl-test-id"),
+    ):
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line.startswith("data: "):
+            continue
+        payload = line[len("data: ") :]
+        if payload != "[DONE]":
+            chunks.append(json.loads(payload))
+    assert chunks
+    # The echoed text arrives as a content delta after the role chunk.
+    echo_deltas = [
+        choice["delta"]["content"]
+        for chunk in chunks
+        for choice in chunk.get("choices", [])
+        if choice.get("delta", {}).get("content")
+    ]
+    assert echo_deltas and echo_deltas[0].startswith("Describe this image:")

@@ -442,6 +442,24 @@ def get_chat_request_role(self, request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> str:
             return self.response_role
         return request.messages[-1]["role"]
 
+    def _get_echo_text(self, conversation: list[ConversationMessage], role: str) -> str:
+        """Return the text to echo for the ``echo`` response field.
+
+        Echoes the content of the last message when its role matches. For
+        multimodal content lists, only the text parts can be represented in
+        the text response, so other parts (e.g. images) are skipped.
+        """
+        if not (
+            conversation
+            and "content" in conversation[-1]
+            and conversation[-1].get("role") == role
+        ):
+            return ""
+        content = conversation[-1]["content"] or ""
+        if not isinstance(content, list):
+            return content
+        return "\n".join(part["text"] for part in content if part.get("type") == "text")
+
